ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels with a low global contrast ratio; high-intensity (white) pixels are restricted to localized anomalies and barnacle clusters rather than pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark charcoal distribution across 95% of the visible surface; subtle, low-contrast lighter gray mottling and dendritic patterns are visible in the central regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute U-shaped notch located at the central vertical axis with a narrow bounding-box width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations characterized by multiple jagged peaks and deep indentations across the entire lateral span of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the lower trailing edges, tapering to sharp, upward-turned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, light-toned clusters of circular barnacles (Coronula diadema) concentrated heavily on the distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous vertical and diagonal light-gray linear tracks (rake marks) distributed across the ventral surface, particularly prominent on the inner-mid section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the fluke tips and multiple visible scratch-pattern lesions across the pigmentation surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme distal tips exhibit heavy calcified accumulation, creating a distinctive rough-textured, high-intensity perimeter against the water background.
